Name: Jurassic Valley
Author: mcalderwood
Description: The mod changes Lewis's character to look like John Hammond from Jurassic Park (it does not change his name). The Aquamarine shirt is replaced with an Owen Grady-styled shirt based off Jurassic World and can be made at the sewing machine with cloth and duck mayonnaise. Your horse is replaced with a velociraptor.

Manifest.Name: Jurassic Valley
Manifest.Description: This replaces your horse with a raptor, the teal shirt with a Owen Grady-inspired shirt, and replaces Lewis with John Hammond.
